# Security Policy

For Mainstream OS security documentation, supported versions, and vulnerability reporting instructions, see:

- **Website:** [mainstreamos.org/#security](https://mainstreamos.org/#security)
- **Report a vulnerability privately:** [GitHub Security Advisories (`MainstreamOS/dots-hyprland`)](https://github.com/MainstreamOS/dots-hyprland/security/advisories/new) or [mainstreamlinuxos@gmail.com](mailto:mainstreamlinuxos@gmail.com) (`[SECURITY]`)
